outline:
I)數位通訊系統/通訊理論
II)行動/無線傳輸技術:基礎和最新發展如B5G/6G D2D、SCMA 、NOMA、RIS
III)無線多媒體通訊
schedule:
Part I Digital Communication Systems
-Background Review (linear algebra, probability) (optional)
-Digital communications
Part II Mobile/Wireless Transmissition Technology Fundamentals and Recent Advances
-Mobile communication fundamentals
-Multiple Access (MA) Systems /SCMA for B5G/6G (new)
-Data detection/interference cancellation for MA systems
-MIMO(Spatial Multiplexing/MU-MIMO/STBC/distributed STBC/beamforming)
-OFDM(A) (principle/synchronization/channel estimation/power allocation)
-5G  key tech application scenerios and B5G/6G  NOMA(Non-Orthogonal Mulptiple Access)、SCMA(Sparse Code Mulptiple Access)、RIS(Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface)
Part III Wireless Multimedia Communications
- Information theory &  video source coding
- Error Resilience  video cross-layer  optimization problem foumulation and solution (AMC MDC HARQ)
- case study UAV NOMA pratical video tranmission PSNR decoder (optional)
